subject: Social Media
title: The YouTube Revolution
description: A micro-lesson that makes The YouTube Revolution usable.

hook.text: In 2006, a teenager filming himself in his bedroom got more views than CNN. YouTube changed fame.

buildup.text: YouTube democratized video. Anyone with a camera could broadcast. No studio, no network, no permission.

discovery.text: The platform's Partner Program let creators monetize views. Content became a career path, not a hobby.

twist.text: YouTube fame is unstable. The algorithm changes, views drop overnight, and creators burn out fast.

climax.text: Top YouTubers now rival TV networks in viewership. MrBeast consistently outdraws major cable channels.

punchline.text: The bedroom studio replaced the broadcast tower.

quiz.question: What made YouTube revolutionary for content creators?
options: Anyone could broadcast and eventually earn money
It was owned by a TV network
